50.firstPrinciples: Resource accounts trace finished equipment into net factory feed, manufacturing yield, recycled and primary supply, then ore grade and recovery. The approach preserves electricity needed for the clean-energy transition and essential development, with additional demand shown explicitly. It counts the full operating life, repair and recovery rather than purchase mass alone.
